contexts.text: The earth is replenished when there are many truths and goods. AC 984.
Decision, consummation, fulfilment.
They filled their vessels ()... To fill, being gratis, = to be endowed.
Forty days were fulfilled to him () = a state of preparation by means of temptations. AC 6506.
The land was filled with them () = even to a fullness of the Church.
Unless these scientifics are filled with truths less general...
The houses of the Egyptians were filled... ()... To fill = to take possession of.
That is said to be universally regnant which fills the whole mind.
The impletion of good. Signified.
(How the Lord fulfilled the Law.)
Everyone, whether he is damned or saved, has a certain measure, which can be filled...
My soul shall be filled () = delight.
Fill an omer with it () = the highest degree of power.
I will fill the number of thy days () = even to a full state.

Thou shalt fill the hand of Aaron... ()... By the filling of the hands there took place the inauguration to represent the Lord as to Divine truth from Divine good, and thus power. AC 10076. AC 10076:6. AC 10076:7.
The process of the filling of the hands. Described.

As the influx and communication of Divine truth from the Lord, and its reception in the Heavens, is signified by the filling of the hands, therefore by it is also signified purification from evils and falsities... Illustrated.
To fill after Jehovah (; ) = to do according to the Divine truth: and thus there is signified what is receptive of it.
The filling of the hands = inauguration to represent the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine good, and what is communicative and receptive of it in the Heavens. AC 10106.
To fill their hand () = to receive Divine truth. To fill the hand = to represent the Lord as to the Divine truth, and what is communicative and receptive of it there.
The filling of the hand was a representative of His influx thence into the Heavens and the Church.

Seven days thou shalt fill their hand () = a representative of the Lord's plenary power in the Heavens by means of influx from the Divine good of the Divine love of His Divine Human... To fill the hand = a representative of the Lord's Divine power in the Heavens, and of what is communicative and receptive there; and this is effected by means of influx from the Divine good of His Divine love from His Divine Human.

To fulfil all the righteousness of God () = to subjugate the Hells, and to reduce them and the Heavens into order, from His Own power; and at the same time to glorify His Human... The like is signified by there were fulfilled all things which were written concerning the Lord in the Law and the Prophets (); and by the Lord came to fulfil all things of the Law (). Explained.

I have filled him with the spirit of God () = influx and enlightenment from the Divine truth which is from the Lord's Divine good... For to fill, when said of Jehovah, = influx; and, with man, enlightenment. Explained.
In the engraving of a stone for filling ()... To fill = to be of service to the good of love; for the fillings were made in the gold therein...
Whom the Lord filled with His aspect.
Filled their minds.
They could fill it with pleasant representations...
After death... this is increased and filled.
This is afterwards perfected by impletion... For there is nothing which cannot be infilled to eternity...
Heaven cannot be filled to eternity.

That the Lord fulfilled all things of the Law, means that He fulfilled all things of the Word. General article. DLord 18:2. DSS 98. Illustrated. DLW 221:3. TCR 73:3. TCR 85:3. TCR 261. TCR 262, Illustrated.
He said that if that bird were infilled with matter...
Sometimes the Lord fills an Angel with His Divine... AR 465.
To consummate to fulfil...
That now will be fulfilled that which has not been fulfilled before. Signified.
That the Divine fills all things, and by such impletion preserves them in the state in which they were created...
The Lord fills all with His spirit...
The Lord... fulfilled all the good and all the truth that is in the Word. Explained.
Whom He has filled with His spirit...
That all things of faith are filled from inmost things.
Ideas are more filled by the Lord while the man does not attend, or want himself to fill them...
Those who are filled () = those who have the Word, which contains all the Knowledges of good and truth.
That those who are in ignorance of Knowledges shall be enriched, is signified by He hath filled the hungry with good things (.)
The days of thy mourning shall be fulfilled ()... = that they shall be ended; and thus that they will be in truths from good.
He fills an Angel with His sight, and thus with His presence from afar...
That without the fulfilling of the Law there is no salvation. Explained.
